zh.title: 立榮申請停飛台北花蓮航線 花蓮空運恐全斷
zh.summary: 立榮申請停飛台北花蓮；華信已申請停飛高雄花蓮與台中花蓮，民航局審查中
body: 繼華信航空申請停飛高雄-花蓮與台中-花蓮航線後，立榮航空日前也向民航局提出申請停飛台北-花蓮航線，民航局於2026年8月17日證實已收到申請，目前都在審查中。
花蓮縣政府觀光處長余明勲表示，尊重航空公司商業考量，但地方有民情和需求，會向中央積極爭取不能完全停飛。他指出，花蓮沒有高速公路、沒有高鐵，只有一條省道對外聯通，必須要有空運。
報導指出，3條飛花蓮的國內航線載客量不佳，余明勲認為政府應考量國家整體發展，將賺錢路線的盈餘截長補短，對虧錢路線給予補貼。

en.title: Uni Air applies to suspend Taipei-Hualien route; Hualien air links face total cutoff
en.summary: Uni Air seeks to halt Taipei-Hualien; Mandarin Airlines already applied to suspend Kaohsiung-Hualien and Taichung-Hualien, CAA reviewing
body: Following Mandarin Airlines' applications to suspend the Kaohsiung-Hualien and Taichung-Hualien routes, Uni Air has also applied to the Civil Aviation Administration (CAA) to discontinue the Taipei-Hualien route. The CAA confirmed on August 17, 2026, that it has received the applications and all are under review.

Hualien County Tourism Department chief Yu Ming-hsun said the county respects the airlines' commercial considerations but will actively urge the central government not to allow a complete suspension, citing local needs.

The report noted that all three domestic routes to Hualien suffer from low load factors. Yu argued the government should consider overall national development, cross-subsidising loss-making routes with profits from profitable ones.

zh.title: 英國航空A321neo客機裝載行李前行李櫃於停機坪起火
zh.summary: 英國航空一架A321neo客機準備後推前，停機坪裝載作業區突發行李櫃起火事件。
body: 根據外媒 Simple Flying 報導，一架英國航空（British Airways）空中巴士 A321neo 客機在機場停機坪準備執行後推作業前，現場發生行李櫃起火事故。相關報導指出，該起火事件發生的地點位於停機坪作業區域。
報導顯示，火勢爆發的時刻正處於行李櫃準備裝載至航機之前的關鍵階段。事件發生時，該架空中巴士 A321neo 客機正停留於停機坪，尚未開始執行後推程序。
根據已知訊息，本次火警發生於地面行李裝載階段與航機後推前夕，事件直接涉及準備裝載至該架英國航空客機上的行李櫃。

en.title: Baggage Container Catches Fire Near British Airways A321neo Before Pushback
en.summary: A baggage container caught fire on the apron near a British Airways A321neo before loading and pushback.
body: According to reporting by aviation news outlet Simple Flying, a baggage container caught fire on the airport apron shortly before it was due to be loaded onto a British Airways Airbus A321neo aircraft.
The fire broke out on the ground in the apron area just moments before the aircraft was scheduled to begin its pushback from the position.
The safety event occurred during pre-flight ground handling operations, directly involving a baggage container intended for the flight prior to the aircraft starting its pushback procedure.
The container caught fire right before loading, while the British Airways aircraft remained stationary on the apron.

zh.title: 澳洲批准雪梨機場（SYD）2045總體規劃 擬打造單一綜合航廈
zh.summary: 澳洲政府批准雪梨機場2045年總體規劃；預計2045年整合航廈並服務逾7200萬旅客。
body: 澳洲政府已正式批准雪梨機場的《2045年總體規劃》（Master Plan 2045），為該機場國內航廈區域的大規模重建奠定基礎。澳洲基礎設施、交通、區域發展暨地方政府部長凱瑟琳·金（Catherine King）於2026年8月14日批准該計劃，提供雪梨機場未來二十年投資航廈容量、交通連接與旅客設施的政策框架。
這項總體規劃的核心項目，是針對雪梨金斯福德·史密斯機場的國內航廈區域進行全面整修。目前雪梨機場的國內、區域與國際航線營運處於分離狀態，重建計劃將把這三類服務整合至單一的綜合航廈內，旨在隨著航空客運量成長，進一步優化旅客的流程與出入體驗。
雪梨機場執行長斯科特·查爾頓（Scott Charlton）表示，獲得政府批准為機場提供了明確的方向，以規劃未來需求並投入雪梨未來數十年所需的基礎設施建設。他強調，該規劃旨在支持永續與負責任的成長，重點放在降低對環境的影響，並在發展過程中與周邊社區保持緊密合作。
根據《2045年總體規劃》的預測，雪梨機場預計到2045年每年將處理超過7,200萬名旅客，其中包含3,640萬名國際旅客以及3,620萬名國內與區域旅客。伴隨客運量成長，機場每年對經濟的貢獻預計將增加至約700億澳元，而機場提供的直接就業機會預計將成長至超過10.5萬個。
此外，該總體規劃亦納入了雪梨機場的五年《機場環境策略》，制定減碳、增強氣候韌性及支持永續營運的具體步驟。查爾頓對澳洲政府與金部長的核准表示感謝，並感謝合作夥伴、政府機關及周邊社區在規劃過程中的參與，表示期待在邁向執行階段時持續保持合作。

en.title: Australia Approves Sydney Airport (SYD) Master Plan 2045 Targeting Integrated Terminal
en.summary: Australian government approves Sydney Airport Master Plan 2045; targets integrated terminal and 72 million annual passengers by 2045.
body: The Australian government has approved Sydney Airport (SYD)’s Master Plan 2045, clearing the way for a major redevelopment of the airport’s domestic precinct. Minister for Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development and Local Government Catherine King approved the planning document on August 14, 2026. The endorsement gives the airport operator a long-term framework to invest in terminal capacity, transport connections, and passenger facilities to support regional growth over the next two decades.

The centerpiece of the approved redevelopment strategy is the overhaul of Sydney Kingsford Smith Airport . Rather than maintaining separate facilities for domestic, regional, and international operations as they currently function, the plan aims to consolidate all three service categories under one integrated terminal. According to Sydney Airport, this structural shift is intended to streamline the overall passenger experience as overall air traffic continues to expand.

Sydney Airport Chief Executive Officer Scott Charlton noted that the official approval provides a clear pathway to plan for future aviation demand and invest in necessary city infrastructure over the coming decades. Charlton emphasized that the long-term plan is designed to support sustainable and responsible growth, placing specific focus on minimizing environmental impacts while maintaining close engagement with surrounding local communities throughout the redevelopment process.

According to official forecasts in the Master Plan, Sydney Airport is expected to handle more than 72 million passengers annually by 2045. This projected passenger traffic comprises 36.4 million international travelers alongside 36.2 million domestic and regional passengers. In tandem with passenger volume growth, the airport’s annual economic contribution is projected to rise to approximately $70 billion, while direct employment at the airport is anticipated to increase to over 105,000 jobs.

The Master Plan also incorporates Sydney Airport’s five-year Airport Environment Strategy, establishing actionable measures to reduce emissions, build climate resilience, and maintain sustainable operational practices during expansion. Charlton expressed gratitude to the Australian government and Minister King for endorsing the plan, acknowledging the support of partners, government agencies, and local community stakeholders as the airport prepares for implementation.

zh.title: 敘利亞航空恢復大馬士革至莫斯科定期客運航線
zh.summary: 敘利亞航空於8月16日恢復大馬士革至莫斯科航線；預計每週日營運一班
body: 敘利亞航空（Syrian Airlines）一架客機於2026年8月16日降落於莫斯科謝列梅捷沃國際機場（SVO），標誌著敘利亞首都大馬士革與俄羅斯首都莫斯科之間暫停超過一年半的航線正式恢復營運。該班機於當地時間上午6時44分著陸，並於同日稍晚執行返回大馬士革國際機場（DAM）的對飛航班。
大馬士革與莫斯科之間的定期客運航班自2024年12月起因敘利亞政治局勢而中斷。根據規劃，恢復後的航線預計將維持每週一班的營運頻率，於每週日固定執飛。敘利亞民航總局局長奧馬爾·霍薩里（Omar Al Hosari）表示，此次復航反映出重建敘利亞航空區域與國際網絡、重新與世界建立連接的總體努力。
霍薩里補充指出，民航主管機關計畫開闢更多直飛航線並擴大敘利亞公民的出行選擇，作為增強該國航空網絡連接策略的一環。敘利亞航空預計在未來一段時間內恢復更多區域及國際航點，其中包括將逐步對外公布的新歐洲航線。
莫斯科航線的恢復是敘利亞航空近期一系列復航行動的一部分。在此之前，該公司於2026年7月2日恢復了直飛阿姆斯特丹的航線，並於8月11日恢復前往沙烏地阿拉伯麥地那的每週航班。此外，一班來自柏林的直飛航班於8月15日抵達大馬士革，恢復了兩地間中斷近14年的空中交通。
根據航空數據平台 ch-aviation 的資料，敘利亞航空的機隊包含8架空中巴士 A320、2架 A340-300、2架圖波列夫 Tu-134B 及2架伊留申 Il-76 貨機，但其中有6架 A320 與2架 A340 因缺乏零件而處於停飛狀態。另外，敘利亞民航當局報告顯示，2026年7月共有20,315架次飛機過境敘利亞領空，顯示該國上空航空活動正在逐步復甦。

en.title: Syrian Airlines Resumes Damascus-Moscow Flights After 1.5-Year Suspension
en.summary: Syrian Airlines resumed flights between Damascus and Moscow on August 16, operating weekly services.
body: A Syrian Airlines passenger flight landed at Moscow's Sheremetyevo International Airport (SVO) on August 16, 2026, marking the restoration of passenger air service between the capitals of Syria and Russia after a suspension of more than 1.5 years. The aircraft touched down at 06:44 local time, with the return service to Damascus International Airport (DAM) operating later the same day.

Scheduled passenger flights between the two capitals had been suspended since December 2024 due to the political situation in Syria. Under the updated operational plan, service on the route is expected to operate on a weekly basis every Sunday. Omar Al Hosari, President of Syria's General Authority of Civil Aviation, stated that the resumption reflects broader efforts to rebuild Syrian Airlines' regional and international network and reconnect the country globally.

Al Hosari added that aviation authorities plan to launch additional direct routes and expand travel options for Syrian citizens as part of a wider strategy to strengthen national air connectivity. Syrian Airlines is expected to resume flights to several more regional and international destinations in the coming period, including new European routes that will be announced gradually.

The resumption of the Moscow route follows several other recent network restorations for the carrier. Syrian Airlines returned to the European market with direct Damascus-Amsterdam service on July 2, 2026, and resumed weekly flights to Madinah, Saudi Arabia, on August 11, 2026. Additionally, a direct flight from Berlin arrived in Damascus on August 15, 2026, restoring air connections between the two cities after nearly 14 years.

According to data from ch-aviation, Syrian Airlines' fleet includes eight Airbus A320s, two A340-300s, two Tupolev Tu-134Bs, and two Ilyushin Il-76 cargo aircraft, though six A320s and both A340s remain parked due to a lack of spare parts. Furthermore, Syrian aviation authorities reported that 20,315 aircraft transited Syrian airspace in July 2026, indicating a gradual recovery of air traffic through the region as network restoration efforts continue.
